user_story: As a guest, I want to retrieve a booking that does not exist to return a not-found error so that I know the ID is invalid.

positive.title: Retrieve a booking with valid ID
steps: Given a booking ID that exists in the system
When the guest attempts to retrieve the booking using the valid ID
Then the system returns booking details successfully
positive.expected_result: Booking details are displayed for the valid ID

negative.title: Retrieve a booking with non-existent ID
steps: Given a booking ID that does not exist in the system
When the guest attempts to retrieve the booking using this non-existent ID
Then the system returns a not-found error
negative.expected_result: A not-found error message is returned indicating the ID is invalid

edge.title: Retrieve a booking with special characters in ID
steps: Given a booking ID containing special characters
When the guest attempts to retrieve the booking using this ID
Then the system returns an invalid ID error
edge.expected_result: An error message is returned specifying that the ID format is invalid
